fieldValues.title: The clerk: commands
fieldValues.purpose: The contract every caller uses: one command per act, the same flags and exit codes.
fieldValues.inside: bin/clerk.mjs and scripts/: dry run by default, --apply to act, --json to read, exit 0 clean, 1 findings or failures, 2 usage.
fieldValues.outside: The rules a command applies (rules); who calls it (briefs, workflows).
fieldValues.authority_basis: Programme coordination (346e323e, affirmed); a8bc55ef and 926c059f (ratified 2026-10-20). Held by the central group until a group for Programme coordination is chartered.
fieldValues.revision_condition: When a rule cannot be placed in exactly one layer, or two principles on one tension collide inside this layer.
